name: What can go wrong with interior wear-and-tear repairs?
description: The biggest risks are bad color matching, visible patching, and letting a small issue turn into a bigger repair.

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with interior wear-and-tear repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are using the wrong repair method, mismatching the finish, or delaying the fix until the damage spreads. A poor repair can be more noticeable than the original problem, especially on visible surfaces like upholstery, drywall, trim, and flooring.
